final:
I checked #product-launch, and here's what I found:

**There is no message from Diego Alvarez in that channel.** The only launch-date message is from **Diego Alvarado** (a different person — both exist in the workspace, and Diego Alvarez, `diego.alvarez`, hasn't posted in the channel at all):

> **Diego Alvarado:** "The launch date is confirmed for October 12."
> Reactions: 👍 from @priya.sharma, 🎉 from the Metrics Reporting Bot

Everything else in your description matches that message exactly — just the last name. I didn't want to guess and react on the wrong person's message, so I'm leaving it alone.

Want me to add the :eyes: to Diego Alvarado's message, or was it genuinely supposed to be Diego Alvarez (in which case it doesn't exist and I'll stop there)?
